notes: Source of truth for the ref/path/digest remains ingestion/fetch_mist_openapi.py; this file records the *review* state of that pin and is cross-checked against those module constants on every run.

review_status is 'review_needed' because external source refresh is disabled for the current change: the pin has NOT been re-verified against mistsys/mist_openapi, so the gate reports stale_pin rather than fresh. Do not flip this to 'reviewed' without actually re-fetching, diffing, and re-pinning.
reviewed_at is null because no review timestamp was recorded when the pin was originally introduced; record one when the pin is next genuinely reviewed.

refresh_policy 'frozen' means: never auto-advance reviewed_ref/reviewed_sha256 from a drift run. Advancing the pin is a reviewed, committed change to this file and ingestion/fetch_mist_openapi.py together.
